portInfo.description: Port of Nordfjordeid sits at the head of Eidsfjord in Vestland and markets a rural fjord call between Bergen and Ålesund. Larger ships (port text: 150 m+) typically use the SeaWalk — a foldable floating walkway the docking procedure says can serve ships up to 340 m and up to 7000 passengers between mooring buoys — while other calls tender; once at the dock the guest flow is described as identical. The terminal building holds souvenir shop, toilets, tourist/excursion desk and port security. Confirm SeaWalk vs tender on the daily programme before timing Sagastad. Gangway GPS pins remain null.
